reviewData.author: Swift Concurrency overview · source review
reviewData.scope: Source-backed findings from the Trend review. Suggested checks are not executed by report generation.

findings.title: Can overlapping weight edits lose a saved change?
findings.description: Each edit builds a full store snapshot before awaiting save. A second edit can read the same old entries while the first is suspended. Serial file writes do not repair snapshots that already omitted one another. History deletes, goal saves and editor saves share this store.
findings.check: Suspend the first repository save; invoke a second add/delete/goal command; release both and assert the final store contains both intended changes.

findings.title: Can an older weight refresh replace newer UI state?
findings.description: WeightLogManager.load publishes synchronization results after awaits without checking a generation. A concurrent save or another refresh can change entries meanwhile. The repository may return its initial localStore on unavailability or error.
findings.check: Pause cloud synchronization, save an entry, then complete the older refresh with its original snapshot. Assert the saved entry remains visible.

findings.title: Does checkout reject a second request at the model boundary?
findings.description: The View guards isPurchasing before Task creation, but the manager sets the flag later and does not guard purchaseHabits or restorePurchases. Concurrent callers can enter both, and one defer can clear busy state while another call remains active. This does not establish duplicate charges.
findings.check: Use a paused PurchaseClient; invoke purchase twice and restore during purchase. Assert the intended ignore/share policy and busy-state lifetime.

findings.title: Does “Delete all data” really include habits?
findings.description: Settings exposes a delete-all action, but SettingsManager only clears WeightStore and weight-derived features. Habit entries and selections remain. The export payload likewise contains weights and goal only.
findings.check: Seed weights and habits; test deletion and backup round trips across both. Decide whether labels or the model operation scope should change.

evidence.excerpt: Button("Delete all data", systemImage: "trash", role: .destructive) { viewModel.confirmDelete = true }

findings.title: Are imported values validated like manually entered values?
findings.description: The backup actor decodes WeightStore and SettingsManager replaces the store directly. The date and weight validation used by manual entry is not called on imported entries or goal values.
findings.check: Import syntactically valid JSON containing future dates and out-of-range weights/goals; assert rejection or a documented normalization policy.

findings.title: Can weight uploads overlap despite cancellation?
findings.description: Save cancels uploadTask and creates another. synchronize can also upload outside that handle. Cancellation checks surround upload but do not make its remote side effects atomic or reversible.
findings.check: Use a controllable cloud client to complete old/new uploads in both orders and verify durable pending state and eventual newest data. Live CloudKit behavior is unmeasured.

findings.title: Are completed streak calculations still current?
findings.description: DailyStreakManager awaits an assessment for each populated day and then writes snapshot without a generation check. Unlike ProgressTracker, a superseded refresh is not cancelled or prevented from publishing.
findings.check: Overlap refreshes using old and new entry sets and controlled assessment completion. Assert only the latest intended snapshot publishes.

findings.title: Why can the UI and model accept different input ranges?
findings.description: Sleep caps its slider at 14 hours while the model accepts 24. Running caps input at 30 km or 20 miles while model policy accepts 200 km. These are product input constraints defined in two layers.
findings.check: Confirm the intended recording limits and test both unit selections against the central policy.

scenarios.title: History deletion failure preserves the entry and presents the error

scenarios.title: Overlapping weight edits preserve both changes
scenarios.detail: No focused overlap test identified in WeightLogManagerTests or the test-name search. Pause the first save, submit another edit, then inspect durable and published state.

scenarios.title: Older weight refresh cannot replace a newer save
scenarios.detail: Existing tests cover early cached publication, not a refresh completing after a newer mutation. Control synchronization completion order.

scenarios.title: Repeated checkout follows an explicit single-checkout policy
scenarios.detail: No overlap assertion in PurchaseManagerTests. Decide ignore or share semantics, then assert client call count and busy-state lifetime with paused requests.

scenarios.title: Pending checkout explains approval without unlocking
scenarios.detail: The pending branch has no direct test in PurchaseManagerTests. Delayed-approval testing exercises a different path.

scenarios.title: Delete-all has an explicit cross-feature scope
scenarios.detail: The existing test seeds weights only. Decide whether all includes habits; seed both and assert the intended scope before treating the result as a failure.

scenarios.title: Imported entries follow agreed date and value constraints
scenarios.detail: The picker-error test does not exercise decoded file contents. Test valid JSON containing invalid domain values against the agreed reject or normalize policy.

concerns.title: Does changing the range change the displayed data?
concerns.detail: changingRangeDelegatesToProgressFeature uses an empty data set and checks the range plus idle state. It verifies some forwarding, but could still pass if range storage worked while recalculation was removed. Strengthen it with dated entries inside and outside the range and assert the resulting points. Do not delete it as redundant.

concerns.title: Does export preserve the intended data?
concerns.detail: exportProducesJSONDocumentAndOpensExporter checks a document exists and exporter presentation, but never decodes the payload. Useful UI-state protection; incomplete protection for the export behaviour. Add a decode-and-compare assertion for entries and goal.

keep.title: Keep the theme persistence test
keep.detail: This is not a trivial assignment/readback check. It constructs a second ThemeManager with the same preferences and verifies the saved selection survives reconstruction. Removing persistence would break this test.
